details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted block at lines 152-167; normalize_path at lines 240-245; emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count/path-byte limits were removed from issue- and plan-derived file context handling.
  WHY: Paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, `.aws/credentials`, and `.netrc` can be read into model prompts, while untrusted path lists are no longer bounded.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context lines 539-564; marker/summary append logic throughout the function | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The total-output-byte bound (`max_bytes`) is no longer enforced for missing-file markers, binary-skipped markers, overflow markers, headers, or the final summary.
  WHY: `used_bytes` advances only for inlined file content, allowing caller-controlled marker output to exceed the documented context budget.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolveoriginurl (lines 3055-3084), _git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub token authentication was moved from scoped `http.extraHeader` environment variables into URL-embedded credentials.
  WHY: The token becomes visible in subprocess arguments, Git diagnostics, and temporary clone `.git/config` files, violating credential-free URL handling.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 564-585); memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-181) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was deleted, force-tick URLs embed `GH_PAT` or `GH_TOKEN`, and `memory_ensure_branch` performs bare Git operations.
  WHY: Tokens leak through command lines and clone remotes, while `git ls-remote` and `git push` fail against `persist-credentials: false` origins.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: Lines 50-52 (removed broker source and startup) and line 668 (--sandbox danger-full-access) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose path no longer uses the model-provider broker and runs issue-derived prompts with `--sandbox danger-full-access`.
  WHY: Captured issue-derived content can cause Codex to access ambient credentials or mutate the workspace outside the intended isolation boundary.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: Lines 144-522 (deleted model_provider_broker_* family) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider-broker lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while live workflows and scripts still call them.
  WHY: Brokered model phases fail with `command not found`, removing the repository's credential-isolation boundary and preventing Codex execution.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: Lines 85-114 (argument parser without --provider-base-url), lines 258-264 (hardcoded base_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and loopback URL validation were removed while callers still pass the option.
  WHY: Config generation exits on `unknown argument: --provider-base-url`; hardcoding the public OpenRouter URL would bypass the credential-isolation broker.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: codex_config_assemble function (lines 50-137) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` lost its `--provider-base-url` option and forwarding variable.
  WHY: Callers using this wrapper receive unknown-argument failures before brokered model execution starts.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Lines 7, 24-66 (usage text and argument parsing), lines 229-237, lines 241-462 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and isolated process-group tracking, signaling, and survivor verification were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches fail with an unknown option, and nobody-owned descendants cannot be reliably terminated or verified after cancellation.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` function (was lines 493-509) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh:2029` still invokes it without a guard.
  WHY: Judge-fix and reissue-baseline pushes fail with `command not found`, preventing review-blocked recovery.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `review_blocked_*` family (was lines 947-1352) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval and successor-issue helpers were deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still depend on them.
  WHY: Approval requests cannot be built, verified, or consumed, leaving terminal review-blocked actions pending indefinitely.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 766-772) and gh_pr_with_all_comments GraphQL path (lines 833-927) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot bind producer comments or validate trusted approvers, so valid approvals remain pending.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: staged-support restore block (lines 98-237), gated by `${staged_support_ledger}` and `${staged_support_base_dir}` at lines 123-125 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore logic is dead because no workflow exports `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` or `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`.
  WHY: Branch-owned helper changes can still be overwritten by immutable support copies, preserving the PR #4079-class regression.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: Lines 203-205 (git merge-file argument order) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` call uses the wrong current/base/other ordering for applying editor changes onto HEAD.
  WHY: The disputed ordering can produce conflicts or HEAD-favored output instead of preserving editor changes; severity disagreement is absent, but moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly dropped this claim after verifying the ordering.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: pre_assembled_static.txt cleanup at lines 59-68 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup changed a HEAD-relative existence check to an index-relative check, lost `--staged`, and removed the `git rm --cached` branch.
  WHY: Staged-only artifacts can cause restore failure, and tracked staged edits may remain staged and be committed.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: Lines 30, 37, 714, 716, 776, 779, 781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with `ImportError` before tests execute.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:99-102 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authentication-hygiene tests still require `_memory_git` and credential-free origin URL behavior.
  WHY: The tests fail independently of the live authentication regressions.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: "Configure git auth for memory helper clones" step (lines 68-81) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY`/`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE` authentication exports are scoped to one workflow step.
  WHY: Later memory-helper steps run bare Git against credential-free HTTPS origins and cannot initialize or update `ai-memory`.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: "Resolve workflow support ref" step (lines ~20-37 in diff) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow hardcodes `wf_source="shubhodeep1/coding-workflows"` as the only accepted `WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_REPOSITORY`.
  WHY: Forks and repositories using another valid reusable-workflow source fail validation.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh: lines 10-19 (LABEL_HELPERS_SCRIPT_DIR resolution and gh_helpers sourcing) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper can fall through to bare `gh` when `gh_helpers.sh` is not at the script-relative path.
  WHY: Fallback calls bypass `gh_retry` and `gh_retry_to_file`, losing retry and rate-limit behavior.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: Lines 22-33 (label verification and latch confirmation) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A failed label read leaves the `ai:needs-human` latch state unknown while the script exits unsuccessfully.
  WHY: Downstream redispatch logic cannot distinguish a confirmed latch from an unconfirmed API failure.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: "Send PR merged Telegram alert" step (lines 538-602 in diff) and "Cleanup tracked Telegram messages" step (lines 667 in diff) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Telegram steps now require an exact staged-helper match and removed the previous `curl` fallback.
  WHY: A consumer synchronization window can make the `pull_request.closed` job fail instead of degrading gracefully.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
